svg.text: Figure 4. CAND-08 (CenterNet): A Complete Forensic Chain
1. Paper protocol statement
"Table 1 reports single-scale test AP on COCO. No test-time augmentation (TTA) is used for the comparison."
2. Pre-fix execution trace (documented reconstruction)
commit 1e920d3 (pre-fix). The evaluation script sets flip_test=True, enabling TTA. The reported AP in Table 1 was produced
under TTA-enabled conditions, contradicting the paper's stated single-scale protocol.
Trace basis: documented_protocol_reconstruction
3. Induced epistemic contract (from paper protocol, no bug access)
Contract class: RUNTIME_PROTOCOL_FIDELITY | Constraint: DISJOINT_TEST_SELECTION
Predicate: "The test-time protocol used to produce the reported value must match the paper's declared single-scale (no-TTA) protocol."
Contract frozen (T0) before gold reveal. SHA-verified.
4. EpiTrace blind prediction (T1, before gold reveal)
Input: pre-fix trace + contract (no gold evidence). Output: FAIL. Predicted violated constraint: DISJOINT_TEST_SELECTION.
Predicted witness: protocol.test_time_augmentation = True (flip_test flag). Semantic match to gold locus: PREDICTED.
5. Independent gold evidence (T2, revealed after prediction)
Gold authority tier: A_author_github_issue | Zhou et al. confirm on Issues #7 / #53 that flip_test=True inflated Table 1 AP.
Fix commit: 4a3f120 (post-fix) removes / documents the TTA flag. Post-fix trace re-checked under the same frozen contract: PASS.
6. Post-fix verdict
Post-fix trace: PASS under the same frozen contract. Paired correction: FAIL → PASS. Semantic match: TRUE. Localization match: TRUE.
Chronology (leakage-free)
T0: contract frozen
T1: blind prediction
T2: gold reveal
Forensic grade: A | Gold tier: A_author_github_issue | Trace basis: documented-protocol
